groups: Two conservative content groups: style guides and JavaScript link collections. Package counts do not establish independent projects or operators.
selection: Purposeful documentation controls for the two already-inspected article-spam examples. Only awesome-standard is documentation-only; the others include configuration, code or reference data. Labels and root-document selection fixed before scoring.

comparison.status: Previously evaluated positives; reused for comparison, not new samples.

members: Top-level manifest, README and LICENSE files selected by filename. Listings record all archive entries; omitted content was not executed or treated as absent.
